item.title: Goat Life 0.6.1
item.description:
A small one. Your goat has learned the difference between a friend and a to-do app.

  • A friend, not an assistant. It no longer offers to sort out your tasks or make you more productive just to keep the conversation going. Tell it you're stressed and it'll sympathise, crack a joke or take your mind off things. Ask for help and it'll help.
  • Pick its personality when you meet it. Setting up a new goat now asks "What am I like?" right after its name, with all seven personalities to choose from and room for a few words of your own.
